scripts.build: npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/game-core && npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/shared-types && npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/web && node scripts/build-worker.mjs
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/game-core && npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/shared-types
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/game-core && npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/shared-types
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/game-core && npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/shared-types
scripts.build:local: npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/game-core && npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/shared-types && npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/server && npm run build -w @nanjing-mahjong/web
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @nanjing-mahjong/server" "npm run dev -w @nanjing-mahjong/web"
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --config wrangler.json
